title: Right ovary
html_source:
A common folk belief.

Laura Davis, wrote in The Law of Sex Determination and Its Practical Application in 1916: “In the normal female the ovary of the right side yields ova which on fertilization develop as males, and the ovary of the left side yields ova which are potentially female.”
